children: ICICI Securities research report on AU Small Finance Bank

AU SFB has received an in-principle approval to convert into a universal bank, positioning it as one of the fastest-growing retail-focused private sector banks in India. Over the past decade, AU SFB has showcased superior execution with strong >30% loan CAGR, average credit cost of ~1% and >15% RoE. Post-conversion, the bank is poised to enter the large-cap banking space with a distinct competitive advantage, positioning it to continue gaining credit and deposit market share at a swift pace, especially at a time when the private sector market share is trending lower and PSBs are capturing incremental market share. Notably, AU’s incremental credit market share stands at 1% in FY26 vs. 0.6% on a period-end basis, suggesting that it could continue to outpace system credit growth and gain market share from existing incumbents.
Maintain BUY with an unchanged TP of INR 1,250, valuing the stock at 3.3x FY28E BVPS. The stock is currently trading at 3.4x/2.8x FY27E/28E BVPS.
